status: Warm-state durable workload and finite controller measurements passed; cold-state and hard production-profile acceptance remain pending
source_identity: Base commit plus the listed example/doc hashes. All four benchmark source hashes match on both hosts. Core library code is unchanged. This is not an exact release-commit matrix.
measurement_contract: Twenty sequential samples per platform; median and nearest-rank p95 include every sample.
No cache/page-cache clearing and no OS/hypervisor comparison; hardware/database paths differ.
Outcome observation polls at 25 ms, cleanup at 100 ms; active store/observer/instrumentation costs are included.
Resource snapshots every 100 ms may miss peaks; supervised-process statistics exclude nested linked request tasks. Whole-BEAM memory is not host/worker RSS.
Guest commands and request payloads are omitted. Transport starts count client invocations, not worker acceptance receipts; interruption can leave a start without a completed duration.
